characters.summary: Okoye is the general of the Dora Milaje, fighting as a master martial artist utilizing vibranium weaponry such as a spear and rings. She is fiercely disciplined, extremely agile, and specializes in close-quarters combat against multiple adversaries.
weaknesses: Lacks supernatural or superhuman durability beyond peak human conditioning
Vulnerable to overwhelming ranged firepower or psychic attacks
limitations: Relies entirely on physical prowess and standard equipment without innate superpowers.

sources.supports: General of the Dora Milaje, combat abilities, and vibranium weapons.

feats.claim: Fought evenly against Proxima Midnight during the Battle of Edinburgh and Battle of Wakanda.

notableResults.note: Fought alongside Black Widow to defeat Proxima Midnight.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes vibranium spears and Kimoyo beads for communication and tactical support.

unknowns: Exact limits of her Kimoyo beads' technological capabilities in combat scenarios.

characters.summary: Peggy Carter is a highly trained tactical combatant, spy, and marksman who relies on firearms, tactical gear, and expert hand-to-hand combat skills. She operates as a founding member and leader within strategic espionage organizations.
weaknesses: Normal human durability and physiological limits
mobility: Standard human movement and tactical driving

sources.supports: Military background, tactical expertise, and combat feats.

feats.claim: Infiltrated enemy Hydra bases and engaged hostile soldiers using small arms and melee combat.

notableResults.note: Engaged in multiple shootouts and infiltrations.

unknowns: Full extent of her capability against enhanced beings without preparation.

characters.summary: Pepper Potts primarily acts as a corporate executive, but when equipped with advanced powered armor, she becomes a formidable combatant utilizing repulsors and flight.
weaknesses: Vulnerable when not wearing her powered armor suit
limitations: Relies on external advanced technology for combat engagement.

sources.supports: Rescue armor usage and combat participation in Avengers: Endgame.

feats.claim: Fought alongside other heroes against Thanos's army during the Battle of Earth wearing the Rescue armor.

notableResults.note: Fought in the massive conglomerate battle.

campaignTags.claim: Wears the Rescue armor suit providing flight and energy weapons.
Uses the Rescue armor thrusters for sustained flight.

unknowns: Duration of power supply and tactical combat training level.

characters.summary: Phastos is an immortal Eternal with advanced cosmic engineering capabilities, allowing him to materialize technological constructs, energy traps, and weapons out of thin air during combat.
weaknesses: Relies on intellect and technological manifestation rather than brute physical force
limitations: Bound by cosmic laws governing the Eternals' non-interference directives until broken.

sources.supports: Phastos abilities as an Eternal engineer and technological creator.

feats.claim: Created energy fields and restraining devices capable of temporarily binding Ikaris.

notableResults.note: Subdued by Ikaris despite locking him down temporarily.

campaignTags.claim: Engineers advanced weapons and technological constructs.

unknowns: Limits of the scale of matter and energy he can construct at once.

mechanisms: S.H.I.E.L.D. body armor and tactical cover

mobility: Standard human movement and tactical vehicle operation
limitations: Normal human endurance and vulnerability to lethal trauma.

feats.claim: Fought against enhanced humans and alien threats using customized S.H.I.E.L.D. weaponry and tactical planning.

notableResults.note: Stabbed through the heart by Loki.

campaignTags.claim: Uses specialized S.H.I.E.L.D. gear including the Lola vehicle and paralyzed-dart weapons.

weaknesses: Physically frail, requiring a wheelchair or assistive motorized chair

characters.summary: Red Guardian is a Soviet super-soldier endowed with enhanced strength and durability, fighting with raw power, brawling techniques, and his patriotic shield.
weaknesses: Prone to overconfidence and emotional outbursts
mobility: Peak human to superhuman sprinting and jumping
limitations: Aging process modified by super-soldier serum but still subject to physical fatigue.

sources.supports: Super-soldier enhancements, strength feats, and background in Black Widow.

feats.claim: Lifted tons of rubble and engaged Taskmaster and prison inmates in hand-to-hand combat.

unknowns: Exact chemical formulation compared to Steve Rogers' serum.

characters.summary: Johann Schmidt (Red Skull) is a tactical mastermind and enhanced human who utilizes advanced Hydra energy weapons, occult knowledge, and ruthless combat tactics.
weaknesses: Overreliant on experimental cosmic artifacts and weapons that can backfire
limitations: Serum causes severe facial disfigurement and psychological instability.

sources.supports: Role as Hydra leader, enhanced strength from imperfect serum, and combat in Captain America.

feats.claim: Fought Captain America in close-quarters combat and survived blows from an enhanced opponent.

notableResults.note: Defeated when the Tesseract consumed him, banishing him to Vormir.

unknowns: Full extent of his powers after being transformed into the Stonekeeper on Vormir.

characters.summary: Rocket is a genetically engineered raccoon who acts as a master tactician, expert marksman, and creator of heavy futuristic firearms and explosives.

techniques: Heavy plasma cannon and blaster fire

weaknesses: Small physical stature makes him vulnerable to heavy physical crushing if cornered without gear
limitations: Relies heavily on having access to manufactured weaponry and gear.

sources.supports: Genetics, weapon expertise, piloting, and combat tactics.

feats.claim: Fought against armies of Ravagers, Kree, and Chitauri using heavy plasma weaponry and strategic traps.

notableResults.note: Successfully defended the Milano and Xandar alongside teammates.

campaignTags.claim: Builds and deploys custom high-tech firearms, mines, and gadgets.
Pilots various spacecraft and military starfighters.
Engineers advanced weapons out of scrap parts.

unknowns: Exact durability limits of his modified biological frame.

characters.summary: Ronan the Accuser is a radical Kree zealot possessing immense superhuman strength, durability, and wielding the Universal Weapon hammer capable of energy projection.
weaknesses: Arrogance and religious fanaticism leave him vulnerable to unexpected tactical distractions
limitations: Cannot safely harness an Infinity Stone directly without a conduit like his hammer.

sources.supports: Kree physiology, Universal Weapon, and role as antagonist in Guardians of the Galaxy.

feats.claim: Killed The Other with a single gesture and withstood direct exposure to energy blasts.

notableResults.note: Destroyed when the Guardians collectively wielded the Power Stone against him.

conditional.ability: Planetary destruction and infinite energy blasts

campaignTags.claim: Floats and maneuvers in space and atmosphere via Kree technological/innate capabilities.

unknowns: Full potential of the Universal Weapon when combined with different Infinity Stones.
